rows: Practice greetings and introduce yourself aloud.
Listen to a short beginner greeting lesson.
Say common classroom phrases and numbers.
Hear numbers and repeat each one.
Practice asking and answering “What is your name?” and “How are you?”
Listen to a short dialogue and shadow it.
Describe basic needs: water, food, help, bathroom.
Listen for key survival phrases and note them.
Practice family words and simple possessives.
Listen to a family-themed beginner audio lesson.
Say where you are from and where you live.
Listen to location and directions phrases.
Review all week’s phrases in a 1-minute self-introduction.
Replay your favorite lesson and catch every known word.
